name: Internal IP Address Disclosure
description: An RFC1918 private IP address was found in the HTTP response body, which may reveal internal network topology.
remediation: Remove internal IP addresses from API responses, error messages, and HTML comments before deploying to production.

name: Verbose Server Error Page
description: The response appears to be a default/verbose framework error page rather than a custom error handler.
remediation: Configure custom, generic error pages for production. Never expose default framework error pages to end users.

conditions.pattern: (?i)(whitelabel error page|HTTP Status [45][0-9]{2}|An error occurred while processing your request)

name: GraphQL Introspection Enabled
description: The GraphQL endpoint accepted an introspection query and returned schema information, which can help an attacker map the entire API surface.
remediation: Disable introspection (__schema, __type queries) in production GraphQL deployments.

name: Forced 500 via Malformed Content-Type
description: Submitting an unexpected payload caused the server to return HTTP 500. May indicate unhandled exceptions worth fuzzing further.
remediation: Investigate the underlying exception and ensure it is handled gracefully.
